name: Bones of Grakkarond
summary: The Bones of Grakkarond are the skeletal remains of a massive bronze dragon lying bleached under the sun of central Silithus. Slain during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands, this fallen wyrm serves as a grim monument held sacred by the qiraji's Anubisath sentinels.

sections.title: A Monument of the Shifting Sands
sections.body: Sprawled across the windswept dunes of central Silithus lies the colossal ribcage and skull of Grakkarond, a bronze dragon who met his demise during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands. In that apocalyptic clash a millennium ago, the great dragon was struck down by Ossirian the Unscarred, an Anubisath warrior elevated by the dark powers of the city-kingdom. To the Anubisath, this battlefield trophy is a sacred testament to their might over the dragonflights, left untouched where he fell.

faq.answer: These are the remains of Grakkarond, a great bronze dragon of the Bronze Dragonflight. He fell in battle against the insectoid forces of Ahn'Qiraj a thousand years ago during the War of the Shifting Sands.
Grakkarond was slain by the Anubisath warrior Ossirian the Unscarred. Ossirian's triumph over the bronze wyrm earned him immense renown and dark blessings from the masters of Ahn'Qiraj.

faq.q: Why do the Anubisath revere this place?
faq.answer: The Anubisath consider the skeleton sacred because it commemorates their decisive victory over a mighty dragonflight. It stands in the open dunes as a triumphant symbol of their strength against those who came to seal them away.

angles.text: The skeleton serves as a stark reminder of the War of the Shifting Sands, where kaldorei and the four dragonflights fought side-by-side to push back the qiraji onslaught.
